text: Before I take this one, I need to say who I think he is. Forestry first. Teaching after. Then the boat. Four seasons — that's not a hobby, that's a calling. In the off-season, he makes guitars.
Makes guitars. That's a man who knows what a second voice is for.

He listens to the folk rock of the seventies to the nineties. The Australian songwriters — Paul Kelly, the ones who tell you the whole town in one verse. Singer-songwriters who let the silence do the work.
A guitar maker who listens to songwriters. Everything he touches gets built to resonate.
So here's my version. It's about the old man's hands — the ones that taught the son everything he knows about the water.
